# 6 bed detached house for sale

> Rooney Auctioneers present to the market this large six bedroomed detached home, situated on a site of approx. 0.5 acres with a detached single-storey garage and double height. This property provides an excellent opportunity for an owner to establish a large home just a short distance from Limerick City Centre.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 6 bed
- Plocha: 217 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C3
- Lokalita: Clonevin House, Meelick, Limerick City
- Cena: 415 000 €
